title: URL-encode resource IDs in pack API client to prevent path traversal
description:
**Severity: HIGH**

**File**: `cmd/cordumctl/pack.go` — lines 1670, 1685, 1690, 1701

**Issue**: Resource IDs (schema IDs, workflow IDs) are concatenated directly into URL paths without encoding:
```go
c.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/schemas/"+id, nil, &resp)
c.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodDelete, "/api/v1/schemas/"+id, nil, nil)
c.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/workflows/"+id, nil, &resp)
c.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodDelete, "/api/v1/workflows/"+id, nil, nil)
```

If resource IDs contain special characters (e.g., `../`, `%2F`), this could cause path traversal or access to unintended API endpoints.

**Fix**: Use `url.PathEscape(id)` for all resource ID path concatenations.
definitionOfDone: All resource IDs are URL-encoded before path concatenation
Add test with IDs containing special characters (../, spaces, unicode)

implementationPlan.description: Add `net/url` to the import block in `cmd/cordumctl/pack.go` (if not already imported).

Replace all 4 instances of raw ID concatenation with `url.PathEscape(id)`:
- Line 1670: `"/api/v1/schemas/"+url.PathEscape(id)`
- Line 1685: `"/api/v1/schemas/"+url.PathEscape(id)`
- Line 1690: `"/api/v1/workflows/"+url.PathEscape(id)`
- Line 1701: `"/api/v1/workflows/"+url.PathEscape(id)`

Add a unit test in pack_test.go (or a new file) that verifies `url.PathEscape` is applied by testing with IDs containing `../`, spaces, and slashes. Use a mock HTTP server to verify the escaped path is sent.
Run `go test ./cmd/cordumctl/...` to verify no regressions.
